title: Sad it didn’t last
text: Sad it didn’t last. Ordered first one and it started leaking at the nozzle within a few weeks. Ordered a replacement and the same thing happened with replacement and then nozzle ended up breaking off the glass. Very sad this didn’t work out. The glass past seemed sturdy and was really pretty
